The game graphics is amazing 10 out of 10
Gameplay nothing special 6 out of 10
Story 0 out of 10.

Probably the most boring GTA game I have ever played, they need to fire whoever wrote the story for this game.
If you are coming in expecting the story to be anything like GTA 5 you will be disappointed.
Just skip the story and play the free mode or wait for online.
